w30.face: Recast a new trio of original playable female leads for Veles, grounded preindustrial action RPG. REFERENCE IMAGE is an art-direction benchmark for magnetism, eye contact, flattering softness of skin, photorealistic in-engine MetaHuman finish, crop, and charcoal tonality. Invent entirely new individuals. Layout: three equally sized adjoining square close-up portraits in a wide 3:1 strip. FRONT FACING neutral at rest, same eye-height / focal length and lighting, head height consistent; natural chin and both eyes in frame. Distinct underlying brows, lids, nose shapes, mouth proportions even without hairstyle or expression. Beautiful compelling principal actors, without the catalogue/model smile, villain scowl, exaggerated age or cosmetic retouching; distinctive feminine features, ultra-real nuanced human skin with subtle scattering, cheek colour and pores, satin light and authentic strand highlights. Baked-in text prohibited. Each a new person unconnected to the reference cast. A is lean and analytical, B is powerful and sure, C is mobile and bold. LEFT A, 32: a poised copper-haired, pale freckled instrument maker. Delicate elongated face, wide-set tilted smoke-grey eyes beneath nearly straight light eyebrows, a short turned-up nose with a soft tip, and a small, precisely shaped mouth with a fuller bottom lip. Fine auburn hair centre-parted into braids looped at the nape. Mouth gently closed, an intent and piercing gaze; dark indigo collar. CENTER B, 35: charismatic bell founder of Central Asian appearance, glowing tawny skin, broad cheek planes and a softly squared chin, slightly hooded black eyes under a bold straight brow, low nose bridge and a wide full expressive mouth. Dense black hair worn as a short, layered jaw-length cut with uneven bangs; calm resolute warmth and russet leather neckline. RIGHT C, 38: dark chestnut-haired Aegean boatwright, wind-tanned olive skin, a long naturally aquiline nose, very dark deep-set almond eyes, high slender brows, deep cupid's bow and a gently crooked upper lip. Windblown loose waves pinned on one side. Relaxed athletic self-possession as she meets the viewer's gaze, flax and faded green collar.
w30.body: Face recasting of the complete studio lineup in reference 2. Replace the three cast members with the three original women of reference 1 in the exact same left to right order; faithfully transfer their apparent ages, each facial feature, skin tone, hair colour, haircut, expression. Keep reference 2's world, tools, relative physiques, realistic scale, open sighted measuring staff and long indigo coat on LEFT, bronze bell, hand hammer, stout build and russet leather across shoulders CENTER, lean RIGHT boat carpenter in linen with curved wooden boat ribs to the side. All three stand directly facing the viewer with hands, boots, hair and tools fully in frame. Repeat a dark slate studio floor and clean neutral rim light to compare the three. Mature, self-assured playable serious grounded fantasy leads. Filmic high-fidelity MetaHuman-like rendered human skin, natural reflections and anatomy. No crowns, headwear, additional jewelry, panels, text, portraits or lettering. Exactly one figure per third, full-length landscape 2:1 composition.

Quiet penetrating attention, tiny age creases at eyelids; tailored indigo collar. CENTER B, 45: a striking auburn-haired founder with a softly rounded heart-shaped face, warm fair skin, very light grey-green deep-set eyes, a gently broken nose and short broad upper lip with a deep central bow. Thick dark-red loose braid pinned around the back of her head, soft temple wisps streaked with silver. Self-possessed warrior-artisan, lips set at rest, quietly formidable. Russet leather collar. RIGHT C, 48: arresting boatbuilder with an East Asian and northern steppe appearance, weathered honey complexion, dramatically high cheekbones, long narrow dark eyes, one visible crease and one hooded lid, long slender nose with a rounded end, wide mouth and pronounced smile creases even while unsmiling. Straight silver-threaded black hair cut into an ear-length asymmetric crop, off the face except a single sweeping forelock. Two short creases at outer corners, lived-in grace, eyes hold an unflinching challenge, pale flax collar.
